study: Load balance head to head (PR J)

manifest.order: per repetition: every budget, then every case; per case: arm order alternates

decision.rule: at every budget: the 95 percent bootstrap interval of the median variance ratio to b below 1, with at most 10 percent of cases less fair by more than 5 percent; median maximum utilization ratio at most 1; median cost difference at most 0.1 percent of b's cost; every accepted result inside its ceiling with zero violations
decision.note: the rule informs the owner's decision; a change of fairness policy is the owner's
